caption: A vacuum-packed foam mattress is cut open, and the flat compressed slab swells and puffs up toward its full thickness.

sa.check: A vacuum-packed foam mattress lies as a flat slab.
The slab swells and puffs up.
It grows toward its full thickness.
The cut comes first and the swelling follows.

pc.expect: The foam expands as soon as the bag opens, thickening and slowing as it nears full size.
pc.fail: It stays flat; or expands before the cut; or springs up instantly like a spring.

pc.expect: It stays a mattress shape and does not shrink or grow beyond it.
pc.fail: It shrinks; or balloons round; or splits.

pc.expect: It only expands and then holds.
pc.fail: It deflates again; or pulses; or grows then shrinks.
It slides; or jumps; or lifts off.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The foam's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The foam changes colour; or the bag changes; or the room rearranges.
